spacing_hint: How far apart notes sit across the bar and between strings.
default_view_hint: Which view opens automatically when you start a practice session.
metronome_sound_hint: Tap one to hear it. Used for the count-in and the tab view; the notation view keeps AlphaTab’s own click.
note_pills_hint: Shape of the blocks carrying the fret numbers, and how a note’s length is drawn.
string_palette_hint: One colour per string, high e first.
hit_colour_hint: Fills a note as you sustain it correctly.
board_background_hint: Colour behind the staff, gutter and fade.
visible_elements_hint: Hide layers you do not need to declutter the score.
handedness_hint: For left-handed players. Applies everywhere on this device.
mirror_desc: Nut on the right in the click and hunt drills. The tab has no neck axis to mirror, so it stays as it is.
rtl_desc: The tab starts at the right edge and the cursor runs left, like a mirrored neck. Tab only; the notation view keeps its normal direction.
flip_desc: Low E on the top line — for a right-handed guitar strung the other way round. Tab only; the notation view keeps standard order.
hit_animations_desc: Flash and shockwave rings when a note lands
timing_hints_desc: "Early", "Late" or a green + over a note as you hit it, and a late note filling from where you played it. Timing still counts toward your score either way.
ambient_glow_desc: Glow under the tab reacting to your playing volume
sizing_hint: AlphaTab’s own zoom and note spacing — independent of the flat-tab sliders above.
dark_score_desc: Black board with white staff and notes, instead of white paper

toggles.rhythm_lane_desc: Stems, beams and rests above the staff
toggles.chord_names_desc: White chord pills over the bar
toggles.tuning_gutter_desc: Pinned string names on the left
toggles.technique_desc: H/P, bends, PM, vibrato, harmonics, picking ⊓/⋁

bar.label: Solid bar
bar.desc: One block for the whole length

stringCode.label: String code
stringCode.desc: Low E red, high e purple

neon.label: Neon
neon.desc: Maximum contrast on a dark board

pastel.label: Pastel
pastel.desc: Softer tones, easier on long sessions

poster.label: Poster
poster.desc: Flat print colours, matte and bold

mono.label: Mono
mono.desc: Greyscale — rely on position, not colour

view_menu.hint: Change how the exercise is shown
